'''''Idyll''''' was a famed [[Farnican chime-painting|Farnican]] [[Farnican chime-painting|chime-painting]] believed to have been destroyed sometime during the final [[Time/Legends|century]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. However, it was later discovered among the artworks that [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had stored at the [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] facility on [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]].
